content.short: Zignaly is an AI-powered social trading platform and L1 blockchain (ZIGChain) focusing on profit-sharing.
content.description:
Zignaly is a pioneering decentralized investment platform and social trading ecosystem designed to democratize access to expert-led financial strategies. The platform features an AI-driven "copy trading" model where retail investors can follow the trades of top-tier professionals, paying only a share of the resulting profits. Zignaly recently launched ZIGChain, its own dedicated Layer 1 blockchain on Cosmos, to provide the essential infrastructure needed for scalable wealth-generation and transparent asset management.

Powered by the $ZIG token, the protocol features a robust reward framework that incentivizes long-term participation and community-driven governance. Zignaly focuses on professional-grade transparency and user-centric design, serving as a primary hub for asset discovery and automated trading. Through its commitment to technological innovation and the integration of decentralized AI, Zignaly is building the foundational layer for a more inclusive and meritocratic digital economy, where high-quality financial expertise is treated as a globally accessible utility.
content.meta: Zignaly provides an AI-powered social trading marketplace and the wealth-focused ZIGChain Layer 1 network.
